Name: Butch Leah Additions
Author: Morgansmallhead
Description:
[size=4][b]Butch Leah Additions Standalone/DSV Compatible version
[/b][/size]
Update now available as a standalone mod with code provided by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/mods]AirynS[/url]﻿ <3 This version doesn't require any other mods except Content Patcher!! 

To install - unzip the file and drag it into Stardew Valley's mod folder. Or dowload through vortex. 

This may conflict with and is not likely to be compatible with mods that change leahs appearance - this includes Seasonal Outfits.

[b][size=3]> Diverse Stardew Valley[/size][/b]

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23917]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url], much thanks to AirynS!! If used together, my mod will add extra random oufits to DSV's Butch Leah. 

[size=3][b]> Spouse Portrait[/b][b]
[/b][/size][size=2]
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ribeooo?gameId=1303]Aki/ribeooo[/url] made an add-on to change the default spouse portrait to butch Leah (something I forgot about mb) --> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40662]Butch Leah Spouse Portrait[/url] <3



[size=4][b]For Seasonal Outfits [/b][/size]

The image files require the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]"Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic"[/url] mod by Poltergeister. To use them you must manually replace the files in the asset folder of the Seasonal Outfits mod (installed).

[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters > assets > portraits > leah 
[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters > assets > characters > leah 

Drag the files over and it will prompt to replace them. 


[size=4][b]
Credits
[/b][/size]
Most of the outfits are my own creation, as well as a mix between the Butch Leah mods (Summer, Winter_IceF, and flower festival sprites) and designs from the Seasonal Outfits mod (Fall, Spirits Eve). Credit to Poltergeister and IronZelly for the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]seasonal designs[/url], to ashbrass for the original [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1580]Butch Leach mod[/url] and FadedRenn for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22013]Improved Butch Leah mod[/url]. Lastly, credit to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/mods]AirynS[/url]﻿ for the code for the standalone version!!

Graphic design is my passion. 

Let me know if there are any issues or if you have some critiques xx
